import csv
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path("governance/implementation/code-guides")
validation_dir = root / "validation"
sys.path.insert(0, str(validation_dir))
import cgp_validation as cv
files = [
    path for path in sorted(root.rglob("*.csv"))
    if "validation/tests/fixtures/negative/" not in path.as_posix()
]
for path in files:
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        if reader.fieldnames is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"missing_csv_header: {path}")
        for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            if None in row:
                raise SystemExit(f"malformed_csv: {path}:{row_number}")
result = cv.ValidationResult("malformed-csv-command")
cv.read_csv_strict(root / "validation/tests/fixtures/negative/malformed.csv", result)
result.finalize()
assert result.status == "FAIL"
print(f"csv_parse_ok authoritative_csvs={len(files)} malformed_fixture_rejected=YES")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
import sys
allowed = "governance/implementation/code-guides/"
proc = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
bad = []
for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
    path = line[3:]
    if " -> " in path:
        path = path.split(" -> ", 1)[1]
    if path and not path.startswith(allowed):
        bad.append(path)
if bad:
    print("\n".join(bad))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("changed_file_scope_ok")
PY
commands.description: Confirm every changed file remains inside authorized path.
